claims.statement: The /new-project route wraps MultiStepFormNewProject in FormProvider with allowedFileTypes set to every FileType except TRACELINKS and INCONSISTENCIES, and the wizard defines four steps (Upload Files, Project Details, Configuration, Summary), each carrying a validation() function from FormValidation whose errors render inline via DisplayErrors; a step is selectable in the Stepper only when it precedes the current step or was already reached with all preceding steps valid (isStepReachable), Next/Calculate Trace Links is disabled while the current step has errors, the summary step re-runs the file and details validations and reports which steps need fixing, and the Calculate Trace Links button is disabled while summary errors exist.

On the final wizard step, handleSubmit calls fetchArdocoApi — which builds the multipart payload (projectName, additionalConfigs JSON with empty values filtered, type-specific inputCode/inputText/inputArchitectureModel plus inputArchitectureModelFormat) and POSTs to /api/{api_name lowercased}/start, or directly to /api/find-inconsistencies/start for SWATTR with inconsistencies; for other trace-link types it additionally starts a separate SAD-SAM inconsistency run via Promise.allSettled and reports inconsistencyError instead of a requestId when that run fails; every startRun response without a requestId is rejected — then the wizard stores usedFiles plus metadata (including the inconsistency run's id) via storeProjectFiles/storeProjectMetadata under the requestId and redirects to /view/{encodedId}?type={name}&inconsistencies={param}, where the param is "failed" (separate run could not start), "false" (not requested), "true" (same run, SWATTR), or the separate run's request id.

Wizard failures are split: an API error from fetchArdocoApi opens a LoadingErrorModal whose Retry just closes the modal and whose View Files Only stores the still-uploaded files under a fresh uuidv4 id and redirects to /view-provided/{id}; any storage write failure — both during the backend submission and during View Files Only — opens a separate single-Okay modal (ErrorModalFileUpload) and returns the user to the wizard.

The /load-project route allows all FileType values (including result JSON), and its single-step MultiStepFormLoadProject validates via FormValidation.validateExistingProject (at least one file, at most one file per type, at most one architecture model); on Visualize Trace Links it generates a uuidv4 storage id, calls storeProjectFiles/storeProjectMetadata (storage errors are only logged, so the redirect proceeds regardless), and redirects to /view-provided/{encodedId}, with the Exit button routing back to /new-project.

The /view/[id] page polls GET /api/get-result/{id} (with X-Target-API) every 5 seconds for up to 240 seconds: status OK returns the payload, ACCEPTED keeps polling, any other status throws an error carrying the backend message, and timeout throws a still-processing error; each polling effect owns a local AbortController that is aborted on unmount or effect re-run, AbortErrors are swallowed and a superseded run never touches the replacing run's state, and the Retry path starts yet another fresh local controller — the shared NavigationContext AbortController survives but is no longer the signal driving these polls.

On /view/[id] the trace-link type comes from the type query parameter (getTraceLinkTypeByName, falling back to the SAD_SAM_CODE entry TransArC) and the inconsistencies parameter is decoded by toInconsistencySource into four states (none, same, failed, separate-with-id); when the parameter is absent the page falls back to the inconsistencyRequestId stored in project metadata via loadInconsistencyRequestId; displayOptions are the type's resultViewOptions with TRACELINKS always unshifted first, and whenever inconsistencies are shown ARCHITECTURE_MODEL and DOCUMENTATION are ensured present and INCONSISTENCIES is appended; on success the page parses response.result.traceLinks with the backend-reported traceLinkType and response.result.inconsistencies into the same-run pool when present, registers the decoded project id in NavigationContext on mount and clears it on unmount, and renders ResultDisplay inside HighlightProvider/InconsistencyProvider, with polling errors surfaced in LoadingErrorModal whose View Files Only renders the panels without parsed trace links.

The /view-provided/[id] page reconstructs the result with no backend call: loadProjectMetaData reads project.meta.json and decodes only the stored file types; displayOptions are derived via getResultViewOption in metadata order; a stored TRACELINKS JSON (traceLinkType + traceLinks) and/or INCONSISTENCIES JSON is parsed with the trace-link type falling back to SAD_SAM_CODE, and a completely missing project directory surfaces the same banner because loadProjectMetaData then throws; parse or load failures show a non-retryable error banner (retryAllowed={false}, and null TRACELINKS content yields empty trace links rather than an error), and the decoded id is registered in NavigationContext on mount with no unmount cleanup.

NavigationContext owns the leave-project lifecycle: when a currentProjectId is set, handleNavigation opens ConfirmNavigationModal warning that navigating away deletes the project's browser data; confirming sequentially deletes the OPFS project directory via deleteProjectDirectory, clears the id, aborts the shared AbortController with reason "User is leaving the page or navigating away." and resets it with a fresh controller, and only then routes to the stored path; cancelling closes the modal without cleanup.

Inconsistency detection is file-gated, not pipeline-gated: it requires documentation plus an architecture model (canFindInconsistencies), which drives both the disabled state of the ProjectDetailsStep checkbox and the automatic reset of findInconsistencies to false in ProjectUploadContext.updateFormData; how the detection runs is decided per trace-link type in fetchArdocoApi — SWATTR integrates it into the same run, every other type starts a separate SAD-SAM run — and requesting it without the required files makes fetchArdocoApi throw.

There is no landing page: the root route (/) is a server redirect to /new-project, and the nav bar additionally links Load Project plus external About/GitHub entries; all three navigation surfaces — the desktop links, the mobile menu dialog, and the ARDoCo logo — intercept their clicks through NavigationContext.handleNavigation so the leave-project guard applies everywhere, with the mobile handler only additionally closing the menu first.

The wizard's Configuration step works on defaults fetched by FormProvider from /api/configuration (with X-Target-API) on mount and whenever apiAddress changes, exposed via configurationLoading/configurationError and kept as both originalTraceLinkConfiguration and formData.traceLinkConfiguration.

The upload step preselects file types by extension (.uml → UML model, .repository → PCM, .txt → documentation, .acm → code model), and a .json file only preselects TRACELINKS or INCONSISTENCIES when the route's allowedFileTypes includes that type — which on /new-project it never does, so result JSON cannot enter a backend submission.

The View Files Only recovery path is an offline submission: after an API failure the wizard stores all still-uploaded form files (not just the files a backend run consumed) under a fresh uuidv4 storage id, so the artifacts remain inspectable in /view-provided/{id} without any backend result; retrying via the wizard's Calculate Trace Links button re-runs the full submission instead.

The wizard stores the inconsistency run's request id inside the project's OPFS metadata (storeProjectMetadata extras), and /view/[id] reads it back via loadInconsistencyRequestId when the redirect URL lacks the inconsistencies parameter, so the inconsistencies panel can still resolve its source for sessions started by older builds.

On /view/[id] a separate inconsistency run is polled in parallel with the trace-link run under its own local AbortController; its outcome is keyed by "apiAddress|requestId" so loading and error states of the inconsistencies panel are derived during render, only its inconsistencies are used (its SAD-SAM trace links are ignored), and a failed source surfaces the static error "Could not start the inconsistency detection." without blocking the trace-link panels.

Both result pages render ResultDisplay with the decoded project id, and the artifact panels (documentation, architecture model, code model) load their files from the OPFS project directory via loadProjectFile keyed by that id — so on /view/[id] the backend result supplies only trace-link and inconsistency JSON while the displayed artifacts come from local storage.
